title: Semen analysis
what: A test of semen under a microscope. It checks the number of sperm, how well they move, and their shape.
why: When a couple cannot conceive, before IVF, for diseases of the male reproductive organs, and after surgery.
duration: collecting the sample usually takes 10 to 20 minutes
tell_doctor: If you had a temperature above 38 degrees in the last 2 to 3 months. It can make the result worse
Which medicines, hormones, or supplements you take
If you have had surgery or an injury in the groin

prepare.title: Abstinence
prepare.text: Usually 2 to 7 days without sex or ejaculation. Your clinic will tell you the exact time.

prepare.title: A few days before
prepare.text: No alcohol, sauna, steam bath, or hot baths. It is best not to overheat.

prepare.title: Medicines
prepare.text: Do not stop medicines on your own. Tell your doctor what you take, and they will decide.

prepare.title: Where to give the sample
prepare.text: It is best at the clinic, in a private room. If at home, you need a sterile container from the lab.

steps: You are given a sterile container and shown to a private room
Wash your hands and genitals with soap
The semen is collected by masturbation straight into the container
The whole sample is needed, especially the first part
Close the container and hand it to the staff
feel: Nothing painful. Feeling awkward is normal. The staff are used to this
after: The result usually comes in 1 to 2 days
One test can be worse by chance. The doctor often asks you to repeat it in 2 to 4 weeks
A urologist or andrologist explains the result

faq.q: Can I collect semen in a condom?
faq.a: Not a regular condom. It contains substances that harm sperm. Lubricant is also not allowed.

faq.q: Can I give the sample at home?
faq.a: Sometimes yes. Bring the container to the lab within about an hour, keeping it warm, close to your body. Check with your clinic.

faq.q: How many days should I abstain before the test?
faq.a: Usually 2 to 7 days. Too short or too long a time distorts the result.

reminders.text: Semen analysis in 3 days. No sauna, steam bath, or alcohol. Abstain for the time your clinic gave you.
